title: Dashboard Scope
question: Should the user dashboard include analytics widgets in the initial release?
context: The basic dashboard is done. Analytics widgets were in the original spec but could move to v2 to ship faster; adding them now costs about 2 days.

options.label: Ship Without Analytics
options.description: Release with profile and activity only

options.label: Include Analytics
options.description: Add analytics widgets before release (+2 days)

options.label: Analytics Behind Flag
options.description: Include analytics but gate them behind a feature flag
